output_list.reason: The 'buy' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When the 'isSelling' is set to false, an attacker can call the 'buy' function and make the amount variable overflow its value, causing a large increase in the attacker's balance of the token owned by the smart contract and a exploitable large decrease in the smart contract owner's balance.

The 'withdrawToOwner' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When it is called, it attempts to transfer a large amount of ether to the owner's address, which can overflow the amount parameter and cause a decrease in the smart contract's Wei balance.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] + _value < balanceOf[_to] is evaluated, it can trigger integer overflow and return false, preventing any further token transactions.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] + _value < balanceOf[_to] is evaluated, it can trigger integer overflow and return false, preventing any further token transactions.
The 'approve' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When _value is set to a large value, it can cause an integer overflow in the smart contract, preventing any further token transactions.
